Header.value: Listen, correct the draft, and label speaker turns. Replace customer identifiers with placeholders before marking privacy as redacted. Approve only after human review; this does not grant permission to clone a voice.
Accurate whole-call transcript — correct recognition errors, not what actually happened
Optional segment transcript (select a speaker region first)
Training purpose — a lost booking does not automatically mean poor service
Transcript score: accuracy 25, listening 20, professionalism 20, next step 25, efficiency 10. AI scores are suggestions.
Critical failures — select none only when no critical failure applies
Score evidence and reasoning — check quoted lines and timestamps against the recording
Audio delivery: interruptions, pace and tone require listening
Observed outcome — separate from technique and never inferred from booking claims alone
Positive example: copy only the useful, accurately transcribed CUSTOMER: / STAFF: exchange below. Omit poor technique and private details.
Optional audio clip: enter BOTH start and end seconds. Export makes a separate WAV and leaves the original intact. Text redaction does not redact audio.
Negative example: same customer context, actual poor reply, and the better reply Cory should prefer. Better reply is a rewrite, not a transcript correction.
Human review disposition (approval is never automatic)
Privacy review of corrected text (original audio remains private and unredacted)
Quality notes: transcription errors, noise, uncertain speaker, or corrections needed
